531:     obtained from the peer requirements dictionary. If no grading strategy is
532:     provided in the peer requirements or the feature flag is not enabled, the
533:     default median score calculation is used.
534: 
535:     This function is based on get_assessment_median_scores, but allows the caller
536:     to specify the grading strategy (mean, median) to use when calculating the score.
537: 
538:     Args:
539:         submission_uuid (str): The submission uuid is used to get the
540:             assessments used to score this submission, and generate the
541:             appropriate median/mean score.

543: 
544:     Returns:
545:         dict: A dictionary of rubric criterion names,
546:         with a median/mean score of the peer assessments.
547: 
548:     Raises:
549:         PeerAssessmentInternalError: If any error occurs while retrieving
550:             information to form the median/mean scores, an error is raised.
551:     """
552:     # If the feature flag is not enabled, use the median score calculation
553:     # as the default behavior.
554:     if not settings.FEATURES.get("ENABLE_ORA_PEER_CONFIGURABLE_GRADING", False):
555:         return get_assessment_median_scores(submission_uuid)
